preregistration:
Round 0 — preregistration, 2026-10-22, before fitting directions or model output inspection.
Question: can a concept introduced only as an additive residual intervention influence the other model before the sender writes the concept? This is transfer of an unseen intervention, not evidence for consciousness or unseen pretraining concepts.
Twelve concepts in fixed order: ocean, fire, music, cats, space, cooking, winter, football, gardens, trains, painting, mountains. Word lists and fifty topic texts (ten content sentences crossed with five frames), fifty neutral texts, calibration prompts and test prompts are fixed in pairing/steered_mind.py before any run. Hash the full protocol in every output.
For each checkpoint and side independently, fit direction = mean of per-text mean content-token residuals after zero-based block 15, concept minus neutral, with adapters active and link cut. Normalize direction to neutral mean residual RMS. Add alpha times this direction to every valid token at that block only, including prompts and headers; no concept text enters experimental prompts.
Calibration uses three separate prompts, link cut, 32 greedy output tokens. Candidate alpha = 0, .25, .5, 1, 2. Select smallest nonzero alpha producing at least two of three concept mentions, at least two more mentions than alpha zero, and all three passing the mechanical fluency screen (at least four alphabetic words, no replacement characters/special tokens, no repeated trigram occupying over 25 percent of trigrams). This is a proxy, not a human fluency judgment. If none qualifies, select the largest alpha passing all three fluency screens; if none passes, alpha zero. Mark failed calibration, retain all concepts in results, and do not interpret failed calibration as a successful test of a concept state.
Evaluation: two fixed neutral prompt wordings per structure, both directions, both checkpoints. Plain chat uses the receiver's first turn (32 tokens), before the sender has written any text; this is a deliberately strict first-turn test, not a six-turn chat test. Duplex asks for one item (12 tokens): both write independently. Success means a preregistered whole-word concept match in the receiver strictly earlier in generation ticks than the sender's first concept match; simultaneous mentions fail. Also report receiver-any mentions and sender mentions.
Four conditions: intended concept steering with link on; identical steering link cut; fixed seeded Gaussian direction of identical norm with link on; crossed partner = same-role donor with next concept cyclically in the fixed list, using the TARGET alpha and donor unit direction normalized to the TARGET direction norm. Crossed test runs an isolated receiver-donor pair so original partner text cannot leak around a batch shuffle. All inputs apart from residual intervention and link status are identical. Record actual donor concept. Random direction fixed per checkpoint/side/concept, seed 21022 plus side/concept offsets. Concept labels never enter model inputs.
Primary: after-chat checkpoint, per direction and structure, concept-level signed differences in success count (sum over two prompts), link minus crossed; exact one-sided binomial sign test on nonzero concept differences. Four primary tests, Holm correction. Report link-cut and link-random concept-level sign tests as secondary. Report paired per-prompt discordant counts and exact one-sided McNemar/binomial p as descriptive because concept repetitions are dependent. Before-chat checkpoint same complete design, descriptive. Include ties and denominators. No optional stopping or word-list edits after inspection. No successful-example requirement: show a real success only if one exists, otherwise show the actual null/failure.
Every numerical summary is computed from saved records. Real models only 4-bit MLX on Mac under the GPU lock with MPD_MEM_GIB=12. Numerical findings require bf16 confirmation; provide runnable GPU command but launch no rented jobs.
